def count_vowels(s):
    vowels = set('aeiou')
    count = 0
    n = len(s)
    for i in range(n):
        if s[i] in vowels:
            continue
        left = i > 0 and s[i-1] in vowels
        right = i < n - 1 and s[i+1] in vowels
        if left or right:
            count += 1
    return count
